biggest_catch: You only get the $25 if your friend completes the full qualification — for checking, that's a direct deposit of at least $100 plus 14 debit card transactions within the first 60 days; for a loan, a $10,000+ new-money loan kept open and current for 90 days. A friend who joins but doesn't meet these earns you nothing.
catches: Checking qualification: friend must open a new checking account, add direct deposit of at least $100, and use the Visa debit card at least 14 times in the first 60 days.
Loan qualification: friend must finance/refinance a new-money loan of at least $10,000 directly with the credit union; loan must be open and current for 90 days; dealer-closed loans ineligible.
Referral cannot be an existing SRCU member or joint member; membership eligibility applies and approval is not guaranteed.
Referral must mention or bring the referral card when the account or loan is opened.
Limit one incentive per new member; no limit on total referrals.
Offer is limited-time and subject to end without notice.

Give the card to a friend, coworker, or family member.
Your friend brings the card, becomes a member, and opens a qualifying checking account (with $100+ direct deposit and 14+ debit transactions in 60 days) or a qualifying $10,000+ new-money loan.
